name: Compound Complex Sentences examples
description:
COMPOUND-COMPLEX SENTENCE
⇒ I + I + D
⇒ Independent + Independent + Dependent
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. I went to school and my friend stayed home because he was ill.
2. She cooked dinner and I cleaned the room after the guests left.
3. He worked hard but he failed because he was careless.
4. We reached the station and the train left before we arrived.
5. I called him but he did not answer although he saw my message.
6. The sun was shining and the birds were singing while we walked in the park.
7. She opened the door and she smiled when she saw me.
8. Rahul studied sincerely and he passed the exam because he practiced daily.
9. I wanted to help him but he refused because he was angry.
10. They played football and we watched the match while it was raining.
11. My father bought a car and my mother became happy when she saw it.
12. He was tired but he continued working until the task was completed.
13. The teacher entered the class and the students stood up as she greeted them.
14. We can go now or we can wait until the rain stops.
15. She sang beautifully and everyone clapped because they loved her voice.
16. The child cried loudly but nobody helped him although they heard him.
17. I finished my homework and I watched television after my friend arrived.
18. He apologized sincerely yet she remained upset because she was hurt.
19. The bell rang and the students left the room when the period ended.
20. You should study carefully or you will fail if you remain careless.
